name: editorial-guard-team
description: Chinese draft editing with source fidelity and document structure review. Host review is not independent CLI validation.

displayDescription.en: Polish Chinese drafts, preserve source meaning and author voice, and review delivery language and document structure.
displayDescription.zh: 由改稿主理人统筹表达编辑、原意审阅和交付检查，保留事实条件与作者声音，交付可对照原稿的中文候选正文。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Polish this Chinese draft while preserving its facts and author voice; return the candidate text
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请润色这份中文草稿，保留事实和作者语气，只返回候选正文

quickPrompts.en: Polish this Chinese draft while preserving its facts and author voice; return the candidate text
quickPrompts.zh: 请润色这份中文草稿，保留事实和作者语气，只返回候选正文

quickPrompts.en: Review this draft without overwriting files and identify changes that would alter its meaning
quickPrompts.zh: 请只审阅这份稿件，不覆盖文件，指出可能改变原意的问题

quickPrompts.en: Clean up drafting commentary while preserving limitations and required steps
quickPrompts.zh: 请清理不合交付阶段的写作旁白，保留限制和必要步骤
